Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Lorar Falo: 29-year-old man, 163 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a patterned collar insert; a dense freckle field; a shallow cheek scar. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
